To: Leila Rappaport
From: Ethan Li
Date: October 5, 5:04 P.M.
Subject: Application for Research Assistant Position
Dear Dr. Rappaport,
I’m writing to apply for the open research assistant
position in your Aquatic and Marine Science
laboratory. I have completed courses in Ecology and
Data Analysis, and I recently presented a paper on
climate adaptation strategies at the Undergraduate
Research Symposium on Climate Resilience. Attached
are my CV and a copy of that presentation. I’m eager
to contribute to your ongoing project on coastal
resilience and can devote as much as a dozen hours
per week to this role. Please let me know if you need
any additional materials or references. Thank you for
your consideration.
Sincerely,
Ethan Li
